summary: Master Corporate Innovation Portfolio Management to align strategy, optimize resources, and prove ROI. 5-day intermediate course with hands-on portfolio framewo
lede: Corporate innovation portfolio management organizes decisions about which initiatives to fund, govern and track. This course is for innovation, strategy and R&D managers overseeing multiple projects who need to prioritize work and allocate limited capacity. It covers screening opportunities, balancing incremental and disruptive initiatives, and tracking portfolio performance through KPIs and dashboards.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage multiple innovation projects but lack a structured portfolio approach. It is ideal for intermediate-level practitioners with 3-5 years of experience in strategy, project management, or innovation roles. You will work on real innovation projects from your organization or provided case studies, with daily feedback from the instructor. Innovation Director:

R&D Manager: Prioritize and fund research projects
Portfolio Analyst: Screen, score, and track innovation

modules: Strategic Foundations of Innovation Portfolio Management
Digital Transformation and AI in Portfolio Management
Integration and Innovation Portfolio Plan Development
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of project management and corporate strategy. No coding or advanced technical skills are required. A laptop with Excel is required for dashboard and resource allocation exercises. Bring 2-3 active innovation projects from your organization to use as case material.
